_comment: Concrete outage-safe Mac profile. Azure, AWS and GCP remain visible in preference order but are explicitly fenced; only the local provider and local storage are active.

backup._comment: Temporary same-disk mirror/read fallback only. This is not cross-provider disaster recovery and must not replace the fenced Azure-primary plus S3 production profile.

dashboard._comment: Loopback-only object/control API for immediate Mac operation. Object and machine routes still require their separate Skarbiec service tokens.

secrets._comment: Uses the built-in loopback Skarbiec URL; the consumer and owner-only grant are explicit and must allow the exact stado-object-api/token and stado-machine-api/token fields.
